# YOUNITED Gourmet Snacking

> Gourmet taste. Real nutrition. Finally united. Protein candy bars, cereal cups, real cheese puffs and spreads that taste like a treat first. Made in Latvia and Slovenia, EU.

## Range
- Candy bars: Hazelnut & Milk Chocolate, Peanut & Caramel, Pistachio & White Chocolate. Formulation targets: 15g protein, 4g fibre, no added sugar, at most 199 kcal per serving.
- Cereal cups: Tropical Fruit, Apple & Cinnamon, Chocolate. Targets: 15g protein, 5g fibre. Sweetened with monk fruit.
- Real cheese puffs: Belgian Chocolate Coated, Dutch-Style Smoked, Piedmont-Style Truffle, Korean-Style Kimchi. Target: 15g protein.
- Gourmet spreads: Hazelnut & White Chocolate, Peanut & Caramel, Pistachio & White Chocolate. Up to 9g protein, no added sugar.
Nutrition figures are formulation targets varying by product and market.

## People
Co-founder Kadir Demir leads product design and development: https://misterkd.com/

## Partnership
YOUNITED works with specialist producers in Latvia and Slovenia; product development, brand and distribution stay in-house. The range is being developed for retailers and distributors across markets.
Distributor, retailer, food service, investor, press and consumer enquiries. Delivery is not configured in this local redesign. Visitors may download a local brief; no enquiry is sent.
